author: sophie.claes@lumivia.be
title: Hiring non-EU employees in Belgium (Single Permit)
body:
This page explains how to hire someone who does not have EU/EEA citizenship to work at our Ghent office.

Non-EU employees need a single permit (gecombineerde vergunning): one permit that covers both the right to work and the right to stay in Belgium.

Steps
1. The hiring manager confirms the candidate and the gross annual salary with HR before making an offer.
2. The hiring manager collects the documents from the candidate: passport copy, diploma, signed employment contract and a medical certificate.
3. The hiring manager sends the application file to the Flemish Department of Work and Social Economy by email.
4. Processing takes about 4 months. Plan the start date accordingly.
5. Once approved, the candidate applies for a type D visa at the Belgian embassy in their country.
6. After arrival, the employee registers at the Ghent municipality within 8 working days.

Questions: ask HR.
